title: Book One · Chapter 170: The Last School Morning
story:
On Friday morning Ronan puts the reading book in his bag first. The display cover goes beside it. He has packed his lunch cloth too. The bicycle bell is still on the shelf. The wooden boat will stay at home too.

Mum checks the flat picture boards. The street map and cat picture are inside. The current labels are in an envelope beside them. She ties the string gently. It is not too tight. Ronan carries the light school bag. Mum takes the boards to the gate.

Dad is leaving for work. He looks at the two piles.

“A very large lesson.”

“Ordinary lessons first,” Ronan says.

Dad smiles. He touches the edge of the board cover. Then he lifts his own blue box. They go different ways at the corner. Ronan waves until Dad turns. Then he walks on with Mum.

At school Miss Wu checks the classroom cupboard. The boards can go in this dry place after lessons. She will lock it then. Until then they stay flat by her desk. Nobody opens them during reading time. Ronan reads his own page. He does not keep watching the picture cover.

At break Leo brings the game envelope. The twelve cards fit inside. The paper cover is still crooked, but the fold holds. They check the count and put it away.

Mei has her pictures at home until the afternoon. She wants to check them in good daylight. Then she will bring them to school. Ronan asks no extra questions. He knows her plan.

The class does sums and reads a short story. The board needs cleaning too. A girl loses a button. Leo finds it under a desk. Miss Wu must answer a message from another teacher. It is still a normal school morning. They have lessons and little jobs to finish before the display.

At lunch Ronan feels tired. He wanted to run and talk about tomorrow. Now he just wants to sit down. He is tired after all the work. Instead he wants to sit quietly and eat. Leo sits beside him and talks about the joke door. “I hope they read the first clue first,” he says. “Then they can find the joke door.”

“They will go home early,” Ronan says.

“They will still be at school.”

They laugh, then eat quietly for a while. Mei comes over with a book. She must give it back today. She has drawn no new window today. She says three is enough. Ronan agrees.

The last lesson ends. They move the light papers to the safe cupboard. Miss Wu checks the list with each child. They will set up the real display room tomorrow. Today they leave it alone. Other people still need the school hall this evening.

Mum has gone home to her own work. Ronan carries only the empty outer bag back. He left many things at school. But everything is accounted for on the list. Each thing has a place on the list. It can all stay safely at school.

Mr Qiu is at the green gate. His Saturday sign is ready under the board. “Is the chair still on the plan?” Mrs Lan asks. Ronan says it is. Her sister will come later now. So Mrs Lan may visit school for a short time.

He puts a small yes beside her name at home. Now Mrs Lan plans to come too. Ronan closes the list. The display is still tomorrow, so he has tonight to rest.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：accounted for＝已核对、知道去向；outer＝外层的；daylight＝白天的光线。

情节提示：labels＝标签；crooked＝不平直的；cupboard＝柜子。

理解：1. Ronan 为什么先装阅读课本？2. 正式展示房间在周五放学后是什么状态？
